Name: learning_rate_warmup
Title: Does Linear Learning-Rate Warmup Help Small Networks Escape Early Plateaus?
Experiment: Add a linear warmup schedule to the SGD optimiser (warmup length as a fraction of total steps), sweep warmup fractions {0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2} at a higher peak learning rate, and compare steps to target accuracy and final loss against the constant-rate baseline.

Name: gradient_noise_injection
Title: Annealed Gradient Noise as an Implicit Regulariser for Tiny MLPs
Experiment: Add zero-mean Gaussian noise with variance eta/(1+t)^gamma to each gradient before the SGD step. Sweep eta and gamma, and measure test accuracy and convergence speed against the baseline on both datasets.
